# First customer: the founder's own operation (SAFE NOW)

Ultrastable began as the way one person keeps a large research and publishing operation running without a full-time operator. It plans the work, does much of it, checks it, and reports briefly on what happened and what is next. The founder is the first customer; this is not an independent customer, and the results are self-reported and have not been independently audited.

What changed for the founder: far less time choosing and checking routine work; a clear record of decisions; and a handful of decisions kept for a person because they cannot be undone.

What we are looking for next: three teams willing to try a 30-day pilot on one repository each, with success criteria agreed in advance.
